paragraphs.text: Aerona is the main continent of the Domains in Dominaria 's northern hemisphere. It was the site of many of the early HarperPrism stories and featured prominently in the Weatherlight Saga as well. It derives its name from an ancient fertility goddess who, according to legend, sacrificed herself to let people take crops from her body.
North Aerona is the part of the continent that lies north of Hurloon . The climate in the northernmost part of Aerona is similar to that of the nearby island of Icehaven .
Bade Mountains - mountain range in the center of the landmass
Badlands - tall spires, ridges, and mesas riven in a thousand places by ravines, gulleys, and arroyos
Cape Tempest - the wooded nation at the eastern tip of North Aerona Coraleon - the city of continued festival, where every emotion is celebrated The Gutted Cockatrice - a tavern

The Godstone - a stone pillar in the woods which can heal and reverse aging, but also kill. Also called the Pillar of Stone and the Stone of Mana . Over six feet tall with a rounded cap, the stone is inscribed with swirls of ancient writing. Mostly chalk colored, the stone is lined with veins of green, gold, black, and red. It was worshiped by orcs, dwarves, and hill giants, who warred over who controlled it until it was lost to time and the elements. Speculated to be an enormous block of solidified mana or an artifact enchanted with incredible power. Possibly the same monolith by which Gull and Greensleeves fought Towser .
The High Marches - the land commander Thorking was from
Ice Rime Hills - grassy pine barrens with pockets of hardwood trees that shelter mule deer, goats, and stunted bison. Concord - a port city Oyster Bay - a large seaport
K'Cur Mountains - the most northerly mountain range of Aerona Teeka's Shop of Wonders - a workshop selling artifact creatures
Muronia - a blighted land, corrupted with cold
The Shore - a town on the coast near the K'Curs, which is ruled by a viceroy
Skerry - a town where trail guards can be hired.
Smoke Mountains - jagged ranges of volcanic peaks Bywater - a mountain town Hammerheim - a fortress Myrion - a walled city
Whispering Woods - a vast, magical forest of echoing whispers, home to many sylvan creatures Greensleeves's Grove - a treehouse dwelling where Greensleeves settled.
Wild Woods - a non-magical forest just east of the Whispering Woods
Wrenna - home of the black knights Jenges - a city on the eastern shore of the Sea of Whales .
The largest part of the landmass of Aerona lies south of the narrower isthmus near Hurloon.
Barbar - a forest of apes
Benalia - a powerful military-forward nation, the former location of the Sheoltun Empire . See Benalia for more specific locations.
Durkwood - a wild forest between Llanowar and Benalia . It is noted for its boars , beasts , and giants .
Erg Mirab - a large dune desert The Aerie - home of the flying men of the Haari tribe Indorin's Tomb - A fortress tomb in the mountains of the Mirab
Fors Basin - a coastal riverland. The Llanowar rivers (among them the Fors river) have their outlet to the sea here.

Hurloon - mountainous region of minotaurs Dwarven Hold - ancient settlement rich in mana Kaldroom - a garrison city, destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion . Morningstar Falls - a waterfall falling from a high cliff into the Hurloon valley Morningstar River - the river that runs through the Hurloon valley
Ironclaw Mountains - ranges that home orcs , goblins and dwarves

Janar - a city of assassins . The city was formerly known as "Hujek". Its exact location is unknown, but it lies somewhere east of the Tonga Mountains and Estark , possibly in the Green Lands or Sursi .

Kush - land of festivals Estark - high barony and location of the Festival of the Arena The Estark Arena - where the festival takes place Farndrel The Seven Dragons Inn Jor - where Hammen was from Tantium - a port city
La - southern cape, famous for wood carvings
Llanowar - gigantic lush forest ruled by elves . See Llanowar for detailed locations.
Morningbrook - a human village near Hurloon

Mount Canval - a chilly three-peaked mountain somewhere on the western coast of Aerona, possibly part of Kush . It is famous among the assassins of Janar as the location where Bethanelle finally received the gift of death from her son Necros .
Nalathni - land near Sursi, home to small home of the Nalathni Dragon . These small but intelligent dragons and their Olesian allies held back the tide of Pashalik Mons 's hordes of goblin raiders.

Red Iron Mountains - iron-rich mining mountains Automatown - a bustling mountain settlement of artificers and traders centered on the creation and trade of magical and clockwork constructs. Grover's - a lone tavern attracting a diverse set of patrons Peregrinator Complex - an abandoned monastery
Rundvelt - mountains near Sursi, home of goblin tribes

The Southlands - the lands south and east of Estark Gish - a back-country vineyard barony near the Green Lands Green Lands - centaur wilderlands Broken Toe Mountain - a lone mountain used as a landmark

Suder River - forms the effective border between Benalia and Llanowar . Sylvayn - a town on the river, just outside the border of Llanowar and beyond the control of Benalia The Mighty Boar Inn The Salty Nymph - a pub
Tonga Mountains - a mountain range on the west coast of South Aerona, bordering the Erg Mirab desert in the east, and Llanowar in the north.
Venaria - a mountainous peninsula east of the Erg Mirab and the Plains of Sursi . It is infamous for its veins of sleep-inducing enchanted gold .
Andrion Bay - the bay south of the peninsula upon which Benalia City is located. It is named after Benalia 's legendary founder, Tobias Andrion .
The Flowing Seas - the seas between southern Aerona and nearby islands.
Honeyed Sea - the sea to the south of Aerona
The Rip - the strait that separates Aerona from Icehaven in the northwest
Sea of Avenant - the sea between Benalia and Avenant
Sea of Fire - the sea to the west of North Aerona. It derives its name from the glorious sunsets that reflect on its waters.
Sea of Whales - the sea to the east of North Aerona
Visceral Sea - the sea to the west of South Aerona
